addr: 223, 13th Cross Rd, Indira Nagar II Stage, Hoysala Nagar, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

rev.t: Great basic jam pad with a good old school rehearsal vibe. Not like fancy studios which are jampads ALSO. For guitar players there are some fabulous amp choices as well which is a great bonus.
The best studio in Bangalore for recording drums and also a very good jam pad with top notch gear. The staff is also very musically knowledged and helpful.
Santhos knows his stuff and he will get yours too (stuff meaning your music). The mesa boogie stack is a monster for all you guitar players. Generally a very cool place with the nicest vibes.
